productMovement.note: Only the Chain dimension existed in N-1, so it is the only apples-to-apples comparison.

frameworkDefectsFixed.defect: obj010_inventory.py matched workbooks by substring, so API_ExcelDataProviderFileName swallowed Negative_API_ExcelDataProviderFileName
frameworkDefectsFixed.impact: 376 providers read from the wrong workbook; corpus understated by ~2,450 rows (4,866 → 6,119)

frameworkDefectsFixed.defect: Action name extracted by splitting on / before stripping the query
frameworkDefectsFixed.impact: A query containing a date (07/08/2059) yielded garbage as the action name. That name feeds the blocklist and destructive guards and the evidence filename. Measured impact: 1 row, no guard decision changed; the crash was the only consequence

frameworkDefectsFixed.defect: Evidence filename built from an unsanitised hop name
frameworkDefectsFixed.impact: OSError 22 killed the run at hop 3,391 after 3 h 54 m

frameworkDefectsFixed.defect: --resume treated an ABORTED flow as complete
frameworkDefectsFixed.impact: Would have silently dropped the 3 outage-aborted flows. Now re-queued, with a No flow left ABORTED checklist gate

frameworkDefectsFixed.defect: Validator scored any ErrorMessage as FAIL and hardcoded errorCode ∈ {201,202,203}
frameworkDefectsFixed.impact: A correctly rejected negative case could only ever fail — negative testing was impossible before this run

recommendations.action: Raise the invalid-token → HTTP 200 finding (§5) as a PAMIT security defect. 19 endpoints, several writes, several disclosing data
Fix the 1,153 *_UnauthorizedAccess source rows — they need a credential column, or they remain inert in the Java suite
Investigate the QA app-pool instability (§8) — 85 min of 329 lost to it
Decide the /AdminAPI question: is it expected on QA_MsSQL? If yes it is a deployment gap; if no, 2,104 test rows target a surface that will never exist there
Triage the 348 endpoints returning 404 (25.1% of those exercised) — deployment gap or stale catalogue
Replace the flat 300 s downtime wait with a short first probe and backoff; most pauses recovered immediately
Refresh the stale literal payloads behind the 78 HTTP 400s in the positive dimension
Consider enabling teardown so the 146 destructive rows become executable and created records are cleaned up
